why_retrained: doc 58 SS16.2, registered because it is easy to get wrong: the committed donor R1-W_s0 was trained on the FIRST draw's train split. Carrying it into a fresh-draw confirm would initialise the confirm run from a model fitted to A DIFFERENT DRAW'S ITEMS. The T = 1 donor arm is therefore re-run at the committed T = 1 recipe on the confirm draw's own T = 1 items and re-selected by the same val rule and the same tie-break.
recipe: committed T = 1: 150 epochs, Adam, lr 0.02, batch 8, best-val selection

selection.tie_break: lowest seed index among the val maxima (doc 58 SS6.4.1, orchestrator ruling 3)

codepath_parity_on_the_fresh_draw.note: doc 58 SS5.1's |delta| <= 0.002 gate is INAPPLICABLE on a fresh draw -- it compares against measurements on the FIRST draw's items. This is the check that IS available and it is stronger in kind: exp70's confirm draw already ran this arm on THESE items at the committed recipe and the same five seeds, so exp72's re-run must reproduce it BIT-EXACTLY, checkpoint shas included.
